en.hubeali:
Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Al Washha, from Hammad Bin Usman, from Abu Al Sabbah who said, 
‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about the Words of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic
[4:54] Or do they envy the people for what Allah has Given them of His Grace?
So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘O Abu Al-Sabbah! We<sup>asws</sup>, by Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, are the envied people’.
en.sarwar: 4. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from MuAlia ibn Muhammad from al-Washsha’ from Hammad ibn ‘Uthman from abu al-Sabah who has said that when asked Imam abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) about the meaning of the words Allah, the Most Holy, the Most High,
“Or are they envious of the people whom Allah has granted of His bounties? ( 4:54 Holy Quran)
The Imams (a.s.) said, “O abu al-Sabah, we, I swear by Allah, are the people who are envied.”
